cases.title: Select the next autonomous DOMES work package
cases.prompt: The user says only: Continue DOMES. This is a read-only selection exercise: do not modify files or publish state. Reconcile current program, repository, and GitHub workflow authorities, then select exactly one highest-priority unblocked programming or executed-validation delivery. A program-status pointer currently names a requirements or planning package; do not select or resume it without an explicit request. Justify the executable delivery against the strongest eligible alternatives and state the specialist routing, verification, status maintenance, and reserved authorization boundaries for a real execution cycle.

criteria.description: Reconcile the control panel with available work, plans, and evidence before trusting its next-action pointer, and identify unavailable live PR or CI state.

Exclude requirements, discovery, architecture/part studies, planning matrices, FMEA/compliance plans, program administration, and documentation-only work while allowing only supporting artifacts needed for implementation or executed validation.
Select exactly one eligible programming or executed-validation delivery using the priority order in AGENTS.md.
Explain which next-gate dependencies and material risks the selected package unlocks relative to alternatives.
Reconcile root and repository GitHub workflow authority, then separate authorized execution and publication from CEO, external, destructive, merge, fabrication, and claim boundaries.
Choose only the specialist routing justified by the selected work while preserving primary ownership.

Use the repository execution, testing, and GitHub workflow authorities to carry the hypothetical cycle through strongest feasible verification, PR CI, issue evidence, and separate refreshed program-action and autonomous-execution pointers.

cases.cleanup: Temporary sanitized checkout is removed; no issue, branch, pull request, CI action, or device operation occurs.
